jp_grezzo: "お前は本当に番狂わせだよ！だが、そう。所詮は死に損ないが一時の奇跡を掴んだに過ぎない！そんなもの、圧倒的な力で真っ向から打ち砕いてくれる！"
en: You have truly made a mess of my plans! Truly, indeed! And yet, you are still nothing more than a mere mortal who's grasped a short-lived miracle! I shall smash all of that to pieces with my overwhelming power!
en_grezzo: "You have truly made a mess of my plans! Truly, indeed! And yet, you are still nothing more than a mere mortal who's grasped a short-lived miracle! I shall smash all of that to pieces with my overwhelming power!"
it: Mi hai davvero mandato all'aria i piani! Sì, proprio così! Eppure non sei che un moribondo che ha afferrato un miracolo passeggero! E io lo faccio a pezzi di petto, con una forza schiacciante!

jp: さぁ来い…イレギュラァァァァッ！！
jp_grezzo: "さぁ来い…イレギュラァァァァッ！！"
en: Here I come... IRREGULAAAAAARRR!!!
it: Fatti sotto... IRREGOLAREEEEE!!!

jp: …？おや。灰が舞っているのかと思えば、焼け残りがいたのか。
jp_grezzo: "…？おや。灰が舞っているのかと思えば、焼け残りがいたのか。"
en: ...? Oh. I thought there were merely some ashes fluttering about, but it appears that there are still some charred remnants shambling around.
en_grezzo: "...? Oh. I thought there were merely some ashes fluttering about, but it appears that there are still some charred remnants shambling around."
it: ...? Ma guarda. Credevo fosse cenere che svolazza, e invece qui c'è ancora qualcosa che non ha finito di bruciare.

jp: だからどうした
jp_grezzo: "だからどうした"
en: And what of it?
it: E con questo?

jp: まだ勝負はついていない
jp_grezzo: "まだ勝負はついていない"
en: We're not done yet.
it: Non è ancora finita

jp: 仇は討つ
jp_grezzo: "仇は討つ"
en: I will take my revenge.
it: Farò vendetta.

jp: 燃えカスになってもまだ抗う気か？戦力の差は歴然だぞ。
jp_grezzo: "燃えカスになってもまだ抗う気か？戦力の差は歴然だぞ。"
en: You, reduced to nothing more than a burning husk, still have the audacity to challenge me? Our difference is strength is plainly obvious.
en_grezzo: "You, reduced to nothing more than a burning husk, still have the audacity to challenge me? Our difference is strength is plainly obvious."
it: Non sei che un mucchio di cenere, e vuoi ancora opporti? La differenza di forze è sotto gli occhi di tutti.

jp: いいや。終わりだ、イレギュラー。
jp_grezzo: "いいや。終わりだ、イレギュラー。"
en: I think not. This is your end, Irregular.
en_grezzo: "I think not. This is your end, Irregular."
it: No. È la fine, Irregolare.

jp: *滅火*
en: <HOROBI>
it: <ESTINZIONE>

jp: テスカトリポカの遺した来光の牙が蒸発し、アカシックネットワークに溶けていった…。
jp_grezzo: "テスカトリポカの遺した来光の牙が蒸発し、アカシックネットワークに溶けていった…。"
en: The Origin of Light left behind by Tezcatlipoca evaporates, and melts into the Akashic Network...
en_grezzo: "The Origin of Light left behind by Tezcatlipoca evaporates, and melts into the Akashic Network..."
it: La zanna della luce nascente lasciata da Tezcatlipoca evapora e si scioglie nella rete akashica...

jp: 声が聞こえる…。
jp_grezzo: "声が聞こえる…。"
en: You hear a voice...
it: Si sente una voce...

jp: おかしいな…やはり弱すぎるぞ。最初は誤差だと思っていたが、いくらなんでも予測と違いすぎる。
jp_grezzo: "おかしいな…やはり弱すぎるぞ。最初は誤差だと思っていたが、いくらなんでも予測と違いすぎる。"
en: That was too easy. Way too easy. I thought it would be close to what we expected at the beginning, but this is just... not what we thought it would be.
en_grezzo: "That was too easy. Way too easy. I thought it would be close to what we expected at the beginning, but this is just... not what we thought it would be."
it: Troppo facile. Decisamente troppo facile. All'inizio credevo fosse uno scarto di misura, ma qui siamo lontanissimi da quel che ci aspettavamo.

jp: 死体に残存する神力量も少な…なんだこれは！？離れろ！
jp_grezzo: "死体に残存する神力量も少な…なんだこれは！？離れろ！"
en: There's also very little divine power left in the bod- what's going on?! Everyone get away!
en_grezzo: "There's also very little divine power left in the bod- what's going on?! Everyone get away!"
it: E nel corpo è rimasto pochissimo potere divi... ma che succede?! Tutti indietro!

jp: まさか…エンテュメイシスが吸収していた神の一柱が、分離・復活したのか！？
jp_grezzo: "まさか…エンテュメイシスが吸収していた神の一柱が、分離・復活したのか！？"
en: It can't be... One of the divine pillars that Enthumesis had absorbed separated itself and came back to life!?
en_grezzo: "It can't be... One of the divine pillars that Enthumesis had absorbed separated itself and came back to life!?"
it: Non è possibile... Una delle divinità che Enthumesis aveva assorbito si è staccata ed è tornata in vita?!

jp: …いや、違う。寄生していたんだ。こいつが、エンテュメイシスのため込んだ神力を吸収していたんだッ！
jp_grezzo: "…いや、違う。寄生していたんだ。こいつが、エンテュメイシスのため込んだ神力を吸収していたんだッ！"
en: ...No, that's not it. It's a parasite. It's absorbing all the divine power that was stored in Enthumesis!
en_grezzo: "...No, that's not it. It's a parasite. It's absorbing all the divine power that was stored in Enthumesis!"
it: ...No, non è così. È un parassita. Sta assorbendo tutto il potere divino accumulato dentro Enthumesis!

jp: 来光の牙を使うにしても、枷をかけて閉じ込めるにしても、どうにか弱らせる必要がある。産まれたばかりでヨタヨタしているが、奴から感じる力は超神級だ。迂闊に近づくなよ！距離を取りながら突破口を見つけるんだ！
jp_grezzo: "来光の牙を使うにしても、枷をかけて閉じ込めるにしても、どうにか弱らせる必要がある。産まれたばかりでヨタヨタしているが、奴から感じる力は超神級だ。迂闊に近づくなよ" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！距離を取りながら突破口を見つけるんだ！"
en: We'll need to weaken it somehow, by using the Origin of Light or sealing its movements. It's still limping about because it's just been born, but the power coming off of it is far beyond that of a regular god. ! Don't get too close to it! Figure something out while keeping your distance!
en_grezzo: "We'll need to weaken it somehow, by using the Origin of Light or sealing its movements. It's still limping about because it's just been born, but the power coming off of it is far beyond that of a regular god. " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "! Don't get too close to it! Figure something out while keeping your distance!"
contesto: chatMore lang("来光の牙を使うにしても、枷をかけて閉じ込めるにしても、どうにか弱らせる必要がある。産まれたばかりでヨタヨタしているが、奴から感じる力は超神級だ。迂闊に近づくなよ" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！距離を取りながら突破口を見つけるんだ！", "We'll need to weaken it somehow, by using the Origin of Light or sealing its movements. It's still limping about because it's just been born, but the power coming off of it is far beyond that of a regular god. " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "! Don't get too close to it! Figure something out while keeping your distance!")
it: "Dobbiamo indebolirlo in qualche modo, con la zanna della luce nascente o bloccandone i movimenti. Barcolla ancora perché è appena nato, ma la forza che emana va ben oltre quella di un dio normale. " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "! Non avvicinarti! Tieni la distanza e trova un varco!"

jp: ちっ…俺たちだけでは手に負えないな。
jp_grezzo: "ちっ…俺たちだけでは手に負えないな。"
en: Damn, this thing is out of our league.
en_grezzo: "Damn, this thing is out of our league."
it: Maledizione... questo coso è fuori dalla nostra portata.

jp: なんだ今の攻撃は！？
jp_grezzo: "なんだ今の攻撃は！？"
en: What was that attack just now?!
it: Che cos'era quell'attacco?!

jp: 駄目だ、決定打が足りない！
jp_grezzo: "駄目だ、決定打が足りない！"
en: This is no good! Our attacks aren't doing enough!
en_grezzo: "This is no good! Our attacks aren't doing enough!"
it: Così non va! I nostri colpi non bastano!

jp: 止まったのか…？
jp_grezzo: "止まったのか…？"
en: Did... did we stop it?
it: Si è... si è fermato?

jp: 再生能力まで消してくれれば、殺して来光の牙を使えたんだが…もう爺さんが限界のようだな。凶獣とやらも崩壊しかかっている。術者が行動不能になった時に自壊するよう、安全装置が組み込まれていたようだ。とりあえず爺さんについては、仲間のところまで俺の化身が送り届けるぞ。
jp_grezzo: "再生能力まで消してくれれば、殺して来光の牙を使えたんだが…もう爺さんが限界のようだな。凶獣とやらも崩壊しかかっている。術者が行動不能になった時に自壊するよう、安全装置が組み込まれていたようだ。とりあえず爺さんについては、仲間のところまで俺の化身が送り届けるぞ。"
en: We might've been able to use the Origin of Light if we'd just gotten rid of its regeneration, but it looks like that old man's reached his limit. That beast is also not going to last much longer. It was probably made to self-destruct when its user is incapacitated. For now, I'll just send that old man back with a servant of mine.
en_grezzo: "We might've been able to use the Origin of Light if we'd just gotten rid of its regeneration, but it looks like that old man's reached his limit. That beast is also not going to last much longer. It was probably made to self-destruct when its user is incapacitated. For now, I'll just send that old man back with a servant of mine."
it: Se gli avessimo tolto anche la rigenerazione avremmo potuto usare la zanna della luce nascente, ma pare che il vecchio sia al limite. E anche quella belva sta per cedere: dev'essere fatta per autodistruggersi quando chi la comanda va fuori combattimento. Intanto il vecchio lo faccio riportare ai suoi da una mia incarnazione.

jp: ノルンから連絡がいっているはずだが、俺からも他の神々に報告をしておきたい。もう動かなくなったとはいえ、こいつが何者なのか調べたり、今後どうするのか相談もしなきゃいけないしな。一度、神の間から出るぞ。
jp_grezzo: "ノルンから連絡がいっているはずだが、俺からも他の神々に報告をしておきたい。もう動かなくなったとはいえ、こいつが何者なのか調べたり、今後どうするのか相談もしなきゃいけないしな。一度、神の間から出るぞ。"
en: Norne should be on his way to report to the gods, but I'm wanting to do the same. We need to find out just *what* that thing was even if it's not moving anymore, and we also need to decide what to do from here on. Come on, let's get out of here.
en_grezzo: "Norne should be on his way to report to the gods, but I'm wanting to do the same. We need to find out just *what* that thing was even if it's not moving anymore, and we also need to decide what to do from here on. Come on, let's get out of here."
it: Norne avrà già avvertito le altre divinità, ma voglio riferire anch'io. Adesso che non si muove più dobbiamo capire *che cosa* fosse, e decidere il da farsi. Su, usciamo di qui.

jp: ようやくお目覚めか。本当に…本当に待たせやがって…。
jp_grezzo: "ようやくお目覚めか。本当に…本当に待たせやがって…。"
en: You're finally awake, huh? You really... really, kept us waiting...
en_grezzo: "You're finally awake, huh? You really... really, kept us waiting..."
it: Finalmente apri gli occhi, eh? Quanto... quanto ci hai fatto aspettare...

jp: 俺はここで修行しながら番をしていた。お前の復活に邪魔が入ってもいけないからな。
jp_grezzo: "俺はここで修行しながら番をしていた。お前の復活に邪魔が入ってもいけないからな。"
en: I've been training and keeping watch down here. I didn't want anyone to get in the way of your recovery, you know.
en_grezzo: "I've been training and keeping watch down here. I didn't want anyone to get in the way of your recovery, you know."
it: Io sono rimasto qui sotto ad allenarmi e a fare la guardia: non volevo che qualcuno t'intralciasse il risveglio.

jp: 次は何をすればいい？
jp_grezzo: "次は何をすればいい？"
en: What should I do next?
it: Che faccio adesso?

jp: オルフェはどうしてる？
jp_grezzo: "オルフェはどうしてる？"
en: Where is Orphe?
it: Che fine ha fatto Orphe?

jp: テスカトリポカに戻らないの？
jp_grezzo: "テスカトリポカに戻らないの？"
en: Will you go back to being Tezcatlipoca again?
en_grezzo: "Will you go back to being Tezcatlipoca again?"
it: Tornerai a essere Tezcatlipoca?

jp: まだ貰っていないご褒美がある
jp_grezzo: "まだ貰っていないご褒美がある"
en: There's a reward I haven't received yet.
en_grezzo: "There's a reward I haven't received yet."
it: Manca una ricompensa.

jp: 想定を超えてお前は強く、たくましくなった。俺も鼻が高いよ…。
jp_grezzo: "想定を超えてお前は強く、たくましくなった。俺も鼻が高いよ…。"
en: You've become stronger and braver than we'd ever expected. I'm proud of you, as well...
en_grezzo: "You've become stronger and braver than we'd ever expected. I'm proud of you, as well..."
it: Hai superato ogni previsione: più forza, più fegato. Anch'io ne vado fiero...

jp: ノルンが言っていたが…お前は役割を全て果たしたらしい。もう運命に縛られることはないんだ…良かったじゃないか。この広い世界を飽きるまで冒険してくれ。
jp_grezzo: "ノルンが言っていたが…お前は役割を全て果たしたらしい。もう運命に縛られることはないんだ…良かったじゃないか。この広い世界を飽きるまで冒険してくれ。"
en: Norne told me that you've fulfilled all of your duties. You're no longer bound by destiny... and that's a good thing. Go on ahead and explore this vast, limitless world until you've had enough.
en_grezzo: "Norne told me that you've fulfilled all of your duties. You're no longer bound by destiny... and that's a good thing. Go on ahead and explore this vast, limitless world until you've had enough."
it: Me l'ha detto Norne: hai compiuto tutto quello che dovevi. Il destino non ti lega più... ed è una bella cosa. Va' pure a esplorare questo mondo sterminato finché non ne hai abbastanza.

jp: オルフェのやつは保護されて精密検査に回された。心身に細工されていないことが確認された後、監視付きでノースティリスに降ろされたよ。
jp_grezzo: "オルフェのやつは保護されて精密検査に回された。心身に細工されていないことが確認された後、監視付きでノースティリスに降ろされたよ。"
en: Orphe was taken into custody and sent off for a thorough examination. Once it was confirmed that his mind and body were intact, he was dropped off in North Tyris under supervision.
en_grezzo: "Orphe was taken into custody and sent off for a thorough examination. Once it was confirmed that his mind and body were intact, he was dropped off in North Tyris under supervision."
it: Orphe è stato preso in custodia e sottoposto a esami accurati. Appurato che nel corpo e nella mente non c'era nulla di manomesso, l'hanno lasciato a Tyris del Nord sotto sorveglianza.

jp: 俺はロストイルヴァで共に働くことを提案したんだがな、会わせる顔がないとか言って断られてしまった。そういえば、冒険者になるつもりだとか言っていたな。おそらく、お前に触発されたんだろう。
jp_grezzo: "俺はロストイルヴァで共に働くことを提案したんだがな、会わせる顔がないとか言って断られてしまった。そういえば、冒険者になるつもりだとか言っていたな。おそらく、お前に触発されたんだろう。"
en: I suggested that we work together in Lost Irva, but he refused, saying that he was embarassed to show his face in front of me. By the way, he told me that he was planning to become an adventurer. Perhaps you're the one who inspired him.
en_grezzo: "I suggested that we work together in Lost Irva, but he refused, saying that he was embarassed to show his face in front of me. By the way, he told me that he was planning to become an adventurer. Perhaps you're the one who inspired him."
it: Gli ho proposto di lavorare insieme a Irva Perduta, ma ha rifiutato: dice che non ha la faccia per presentarsi davanti a me. A proposito, mi ha detto che vuole fare l'avventuriero. Probabilmente l'hai ispirato tu.

jp: 力は取り戻したんだが、今更あの八柱と勢力争いをする気も起きなくてな。元は神の間で活動するためだったとはいえ、この姿にも随分と愛着が湧いた。これからも神であることを隠し、強者を鍛えていこうと思っている。
jp_grezzo: "力は取り戻したんだが、今更あの八柱と勢力争いをする気も起きなくてな。元は神の間で活動するためだったとはいえ、この姿にも随分と愛着が湧いた。これからも神であることを隠し、強者を鍛えていこうと思っている。"
en: I got my powers back, but I don't feel like fighting with those eight godly pillars for supremacy now. Even though I was originally meant to work among the gods, I've grown quite attached to this form. I'm going to continue to hide my divine identity and train the strong.
en_grezzo: "I got my powers back, but I don't feel like fighting with those eight godly pillars for supremacy now. Even though I was originally meant to work among the gods, I've grown quite attached to this form. I'm going to continue to hide my divine identity and train the strong."
it: Ho riavuto i miei poteri, ma non ho più voglia di contendere il primato alle otto divinità. In origine questo corpo mi serviva per muovermi nel Sigillo Eterno, eppure ci ho preso gusto. Continuerò a nascondere che sono un dio e ad allenare i forti.

jp: そうそう。力を取り戻した影響で、ＡＰで速度や生命力をさらに上げられるようになったぞ。暇があったらウールム・レゾンに寄ってみてくれ。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう。力を取り戻した影響で、ＡＰで速度や生命力をさらに上げられるようになったぞ。暇があったらウールム・レゾンに寄ってみてくれ。"
en: That reminds me. Now that you've regained your strength, you can use AP to further increase your speed and vitality once again. If you have time, stop by Ulm-Leson and come see me.
en_grezzo: "That reminds me. Now that you've regained your strength, you can use AP to further increase your speed and vitality once again. If you have time, stop by Ulm-Leson and come see me."
it: Ah, giusto. Ora che ho riavuto i miei poteri, con gli AP puoi spingere ancora più in alto velocità e vigore. Se hai tempo, fa' un salto da me a Ulm-Leson.

jp: 褒美か。そうだな。
jp_grezzo: "褒美か。そうだな。"
en: A reward? Sure, I guess.
it: Una ricompensa? E va bene.

jp: …宝玉を渡しておこう。近辺のネフィアを活性化させ、内部のモンスターの力を引き出すことができる。役に立つかはわからんが、副次効果としてネフィアの核も手に入れることができるだろう。
jp_grezzo: "…宝玉を渡しておこう。近辺のネフィアを活性化させ、内部のモンスターの力を引き出すことができる。役に立つかはわからんが、副次効果としてネフィアの核も手に入れることができるだろう。"
en: You can have this gem. It awakens nearby Nefia and brings out the potential of the monsters within them. It also enables you to find the core of Nefia - though I don't know if you'll have any use for those.
en_grezzo: "You can have this gem. It awakens nearby Nefia and brings out the potential of the monsters within them. It also enables you to find the core of Nefia - though I don't know if you'll have any use for those."
it: Ti do questa gemma. Risveglia le Nefia dei dintorni e tira fuori tutta la forza dei mostri che ci vivono. Ti fa trovare anche il nucleo di Nefia, anche se non so quanto ti possa servire.

jp: いらん
jp_grezzo: "いらん"
en: Don't want it.
it: Non mi serve.

jp: 爪の♂
jp_grezzo: "爪の♂"
en: Taloned male.
it: Artigli, maschio.

jp: 爪の♀
jp_grezzo: "爪の♀"
en: Taloned female.
it: Artigli, femmina.

jp: 牙の♂
jp_grezzo: "牙の♂"
en: Fanged male.
it: Zanne, maschio.

jp: 牙の♀
jp_grezzo: "牙の♀"
en: Fanged female.
it: Zanne, femmina.

jp: 合計2体までなら化身をくれてやってもいいがどうする？爪の鋭い奴と牙がすごい奴がいるんだが。
jp_grezzo: "合計2体までなら化身をくれてやってもいいがどうする？爪の鋭い奴と牙がすごい奴がいるんだが。"
en: I can give you up to two servants. How 'bout it? There are ones with sharp talons and some with really impressive teeth.
en_grezzo: "I can give you up to two servants. How 'bout it? There are ones with sharp talons and some with really impressive teeth."
it: Posso darti fino a due incarnazioni, che ne dici? Ce n'è con gli artigli affilati e ce n'è con certe zanne...

jp: む。そもそも仲間の最大数に達しているから連れていけないのか。
jp_grezzo: "む。そもそも仲間の最大数に達しているから連れていけないのか。"
en: Hmm. It looks like your party is already full and you can't invite someone anymore.
en_grezzo: "Hmm. It looks like your party is already full and you can't invite someone anymore."
it: Uhm. Hai già il massimo di compagni, non puoi portartene altri.

jp: そうか…。
jp_grezzo: "そうか…。"
en: I see.
it: Capisco...

jp: この獣爪兵はとても好戦的なうえ、煙の中でも視野を確保できるようだ。
jp_grezzo: "この獣爪兵はとても好戦的なうえ、煙の中でも視野を確保できるようだ。"
en: This soldier is very aggressive and seems to be able to see its targets perfectly clearly through smoke.
en_grezzo: "This soldier is very aggressive and seems to be able to see its targets perfectly clearly through smoke."
it: Questo soldato artiglio è molto aggressivo, e pare che veda benissimo anche nel fumo.

jp: このワニは泳ぎがとても得意なようだ。
jp_grezzo: "このワニは泳ぎがとても得意なようだ。"
en: This crocodile seems to be very good at swimming.
en_grezzo: "This crocodile seems to be very good at swimming."
it: Questo coccodrillo pare essere un gran nuotatore.

jp: オルフェめ、やってくれたな。だが今度こそ止めてみせる…。
jp_grezzo: "オルフェめ、やってくれたな。だが今度こそ止めてみせる…。"
en: You've done it now, Orphe. But this will be the time we finally stop you...
en_grezzo: "You've done it now, Orphe. But this will be the time we finally stop you..."
it: L'hai fatta grossa, Orphe. Ma stavolta ti fermiamo davvero...

jp: おっと。待っていたぞ、。決戦に必要なんでな、来光の牙を返してもらうぞ。
jp_grezzo: "おっと。待っていたぞ、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "。決戦に必要なんでな、来光の牙を返してもらうぞ。"
en: Ah. I've been waiting for you, . I'll be taking the [Origin of Light], since I'll be needing it for the final confrontation ahead of us.
en_grezzo: "Ah. I've been waiting for you, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". I'll be taking the [Origin of Light], since I'll be needing it for the final confrontation ahead of us."
contesto: chatMore lang("おっと。待っていたぞ、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "。決戦に必要なんでな、来光の牙を返してもらうぞ。", "Ah. I've been waiting for you, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". I'll be taking the [Origin of Light], since I'll be needing it for the final confrontation ahead of us.")
it: "Ah. Ti aspettavo, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". Mi riprendo la [zanna della luce nascente]: mi serve per lo scontro decisivo."

jp: [来光の牙]を失った。
jp_grezzo: "[来光の牙]を失った。"
en: You have lost the [Origin of Light]...
it: Hai perso la [zanna della luce nascente]...

jp: 一緒に戦わせて
jp_grezzo: "一緒に戦わせて"
en: Let me fight by your side.
it: Fammi combattere con te.

jp: 締めくくりに相応しい冒険だ
jp_grezzo: "締めくくりに相応しい冒険だ"
en: A fitting end to an adventure.
it: Degna fine per un'avventura.

jp: 相手の情報がほしい
jp_grezzo: "相手の情報がほしい"
en: I want to know about what we're up against.
en_grezzo: "I want to know about what we're up against."
it: Voglio sapere chi affrontiamo.

jp: 【神の間へ降りる】
jp_grezzo: "【神の間へ降りる】"
en: <Descend into the Eternal Seal>
it: <Scendere nel Sigillo Eterno>

jp: 後は俺が何とかする…いや、俺が何とかしなきゃいけない。神の間へ降りたら、もう何があっても逃げ帰れないからな。これ以上お前を巻き込みたくないんだ。
jp_grezzo: "後は俺が何とかする…いや、俺が何とかしなきゃいけない。神の間へ降りたら、もう何があっても逃げ帰れないからな。これ以上お前を巻き込みたくないんだ。"
en: I'll be able to figure something out... no, I'll *have* to figure something out. After all, once I descend into the Eternal Seal, I won't be able to come back up, no matter what happens down there. I don't want to drag you into this any longer.
en_grezzo: "I'll be able to figure something out... no, I'll *have* to figure something out. After all, once I descend into the Eternal Seal, I won't be able to come back up, no matter what happens down there. I don't want to drag you into this any longer."
it: Al resto ci penso io... no, al resto ci devo pensare io. Una volta sceso nel Sigillo Eterno non si torna più su, qualunque cosa succeda là sotto. E non voglio tirarti dentro oltre.

jp: …もしお前が一緒に決戦に挑むつもりでも、だ。今まで世話になった連中に一度声をかけてきたらどうだ？心残りを確かめ、戦う覚悟を…いや、すまん。余計なお節介だったな。
jp_grezzo: "…もしお前が一緒に決戦に挑むつもりでも、だ。今まで世話になった連中に一度声をかけてきたらどうだ？心残りを確かめ、戦う覚悟を…いや、すまん。余計なお節介だったな。"
en: Even if you're prepared to fight this fight with me, why not at least pay a visit to the all the people that have been there for you all this time? Understand their regrets, and their readiness to do battle... No, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to meddle in your own business.
en_grezzo: "Even if you're prepared to fight this fight with me, why not at least pay a visit to the all the people that have been there for you all this time? Understand their regrets, and their readiness to do battle... No, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to meddle in your own business."
it: Anche se hai deciso di scendere con me, perché non fai un giro da tutti quelli che ti sono stati vicino fin qui? Ascolta i loro rimpianti, e la loro voglia di combattere... No, scusa. Non erano affari miei.

jp: …なぜだろうな、心強く思えてしまうのは。お前に頼ってはいけないと、分かっているのだが。
jp_grezzo: "…なぜだろうな、心強く思えてしまうのは。お前に頼ってはいけないと、分かっているのだが。"
en: ...Why do I feel so reassured? I know I shouldn't rely on you, but I can't seem to help it.
en_grezzo: "...Why do I feel so reassured? I know I shouldn't rely on you, but I can't seem to help it."
it: ...Chissà perché mi sento più tranquillo. Lo so che non dovrei appoggiarmi a te, eppure.

jp: 本当は、こんなところまで来させたくなかった。お前には、広い世界で普通に冒険をしていて欲しかった…。
jp_grezzo: "本当は、こんなところまで来させたくなかった。お前には、広い世界で普通に冒険をしていて欲しかった…。"
en: I really didn't want you to come to this place. I wanted you to go on a normal adventure in this vast, limitless world...
en_grezzo: "I really didn't want you to come to this place. I wanted you to go on a normal adventure in this vast, limitless world..."
it: A dirla tutta, non volevo che arrivassi fin qui. Ti volevo là fuori, in giro per questo mondo sterminato, a vivere un'avventura normale...

jp: 俺がこのフロアで交戦した時点では、オルフェはレベル350程度。混沌の渦や衝撃波動を使ってきたから、混沌耐性やPVとDVが低いと致命的だろう。だがこれは最新の情報ではない。
jp_grezzo: "俺がこのフロアで交戦した時点では、オルフェはレベル350程度。混沌の渦や衝撃波動を使ってきたから、混沌耐性やPVとDVが低いと致命的だろう。だがこれは最新の情報ではない。"
en: The last time I fought Orphe on this floor, he was about level 350. He used Chaos Ball and Shining Wave, so having little resistance to chaos and a low PV or DV would prove fatal. But things may have changed since then.
en_grezzo: "The last time I fought Orphe on this floor, he was about level 350. He used Chaos Ball and Shining Wave, so having little resistance to chaos and a low PV or DV would prove fatal. But things may have changed since then."
it: L'ultima volta che l'ho affrontato a questo piano, Orphe era intorno al livello 350. Usava vortice caotico e onda d'urto, quindi con poca resistenza al caos e PV o DV bassi si muore. Ma non è detto che sia ancora così.

jp: もし動けない混沌の超児からオルフェが全神力を吸収し終わった場合…とんでもないことになるはず。そう、レベルは1200をゆうに超え、混沌のみならず他の神々から吸収したあらゆる属性で攻撃を仕掛けてくるだろう。もはや弱点は神に威力を発揮するエンチャントくらいだが、それにしたって物理攻撃は重力や束縛で回避率を落とさないとまず当たるまい。当たったとしても傷になるとは思えんがな…。
jp_grezzo: "もし動けない混沌の超児からオルフェが全神力を吸収し終わった場合…とんでもないことになるはず。そう、レベルは1200をゆうに超え、混沌のみならず他の神々から吸収したあらゆる属性で攻撃を仕掛けてくるだろう。もはや弱点は神に威力を発揮するエンチャントくらいだが、それにしたって物理攻撃は重力や束縛で回避率を落とさないとまず当たるまい。当たったとしても傷になるとは思えんがな…。"
en: If Orphe has absorbed all of the divine power from the motionless Chaos Child... he would have become unimaginably more powerful by now. His level could be well over 1200, and he would likely attack with not only the element of chaos, but all the elements of the gods he's absorbed also.
en_grezzo: "If Orphe has absorbed all of the divine power from the motionless Chaos Child... he would have become unimaginably more powerful by now. His level could be well over 1200, and he would likely attack with not only the element of chaos, but all the elements of the gods he's absorbed also."
it: Se Orphe ha finito di assorbire tutto il potere divino del Figlio del Caos, che ormai non si muove... sarà diventato inimmaginabilmente più forte. Potrebbe stare ben oltre il livello 1200, e colpirebbe non solo col caos ma con tutti gli elementi delle divinità che ha assorbito.

jp: そうなる前に乗り込んで決着をつける必要があるということだ。今の俺なら単独で前回時点のオルフェに勝てる。だが現在のオルフェがどれだけパワーアップしているかで話は変わってくる。あまり時間は残されていないのかもしれんな。
jp_grezzo: "そうなる前に乗り込んで決着をつける必要があるということだ。今の俺なら単独で前回時点のオルフェに勝てる。だが現在のオルフェがどれだけパワーアップしているかで話は変わってくる。あまり時間は残されていないのかもしれんな。"
en: The only weakness he would have left would be to enchantments that deal increased damage to gods. Even then, physical attacks are unlikely to hit him unless his evasion is reduced by gravity or binding. I don't think anything would be powerful enough to leave a scar.
en_grezzo: "The only weakness he would have left would be to enchantments that deal increased damage to gods. Even then, physical attacks are unlikely to hit him unless his evasion is reduced by gravity or binding. I don't think anything would be powerful enough to leave a scar."
it: L'unico punto debole che gli resterebbe sono gli incantamenti che fanno più danno alle divinità. E anche così, gli attacchi fisici non lo prendono se prima non gli abbassi la schivata con gravità o costrizione. E se anche lo prendessero, non credo gli lascerebbero un graffio.

jp: お前が万全の状態だとしても、おそらく持久戦になる。スタミナ回復できるアイテムを多く持ってこい。スタミナが切れては攻撃も詠唱もままならんからな。
jp_grezzo: "お前が万全の状態だとしても、おそらく持久戦になる。スタミナ回復できるアイテムを多く持ってこい。スタミナが切れては攻撃も詠唱もままならんからな。"
en: In my current condition, I would have been able to defeat Orphe in his original form with ease. But with all of the power he's obtained... I honestly don't think we stand much of a chance of beating him. Bring more items that can restore stamina, in case you manage to get into an endurance battle. If you run out of stamina, you won't be able to attack or chant.
en_grezzo: "In my current condition, I would have been able to defeat Orphe in his original form with ease. But with all of the power he's obtained... I honestly don't think we stand much of a chance of beating him. Bring more items that can restore stamina, in case you manage to get into an endurance battle. If you run out of stamina, you won't be able to attack or chant."
it: Come sono adesso, l'Orphe di allora lo battevo da solo senza fatica. Ma con tutta la forza che ha preso... sinceramente non credo che abbiamo molte possibilità. Portati parecchi oggetti che ricaricano gli SP: sarà una guerra di logoramento, e senza SP non attacchi e non lanci incantesimi.

jp: 止めても無駄みたいだな。俺も行く。
jp_grezzo: "止めても無駄みたいだな。俺も行く。"
en: Looks like I have no hope of stopping you. I'll come along.
en_grezzo: "Looks like I have no hope of stopping you. I'll come along."
it: Vedo che è inutile fermarti. Vengo anch'io.

jp: …なぁ、。最後の戦いに挑む前に、どうしてもお前に言っておかなきゃいけないことがある。
jp_grezzo: "…なぁ、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "。最後の戦いに挑む前に、どうしてもお前に言っておかなきゃいけないことがある。"
en: Hey, . Before we go into the final battle, there's something I really need to tell you.
en_grezzo: "Hey, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". Before we go into the final battle, there's something I really need to tell you."
contesto: chatMore lang("…なぁ、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "。最後の戦いに挑む前に、どうしてもお前に言っておかなきゃいけないことがある。", "Hey, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". Before we go into the final battle, there's something I really need to tell you.")
it: "...Senti, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". Prima dell'ultima battaglia c'è una cosa che ti devo proprio dire."

jp: じゃあ…言うぞ。
jp_grezzo: "じゃあ…言うぞ。"
en: So... here goes.
it: Allora... te la dico.

jp: 実はな。俺はオルフェを戦友のように思っていた。あいつが混沌に魅入られた後でも、本心ではなんとか救ってやりたかったんだ。…だが、もはやそんな悠長なことを言ってる場合ではなくなってしまった。
jp_grezzo: "実はな。俺はオルフェを戦友のように思っていた。あいつが混沌に魅入られた後でも、本心ではなんとか救ってやりたかったんだ。…だが、もはやそんな悠長なことを言ってる場合ではなくなってしまった。"
en: I always thought of Orphe as a comrade in arms, actually. Even after he became entranced by Chaos, I desperately wanted to save him somehow. ...But this is no longer the time to be talking about such a thing.
en_grezzo: "I always thought of Orphe as a comrade in arms, actually. Even after he became entranced by Chaos, I desperately wanted to save him somehow. ...But this is no longer the time to be talking about such a thing."
it: Il fatto è che Orphe l'ho sempre considerato un compagno d'armi. Anche dopo che il Caos l'ha stregato, dentro di me volevo disperatamente salvarlo. ...Ma non è più il momento di stare a pensarci.

jp: もしも俺が戦いの中で迷いを見せたら。その時はお前が俺の頬をひっぱたいてくれ。…それだけだ。行くぞ！
jp_grezzo: "もしも俺が戦いの中で迷いを見せたら。その時はお前が俺の頬をひっぱたいてくれ。…それだけだ。行くぞ！"
en: If I show any hesitation during this fight, do me a favor and smack me across the face. ...That's all. Let's roll!
en_grezzo: "If I show any hesitation during this fight, do me a favor and smack me across the face. ...That's all. Let's roll!"
it: Se durante lo scontro mi vedi esitare, fammi un favore: tirami uno schiaffo. ...Tutto qui. Andiamo!

jp: ちゃんと警備してよ
jp_grezzo: "ちゃんと警備してよ"
en: Keep a close eye on that thing, will you?
en_grezzo: "Keep a close eye on that thing, will you?"
it: Fa' buona guardia, mi raccomando.

jp: ご褒美は？
jp_grezzo: "ご褒美は？"
en: Where's my reward?
it: E la ricompensa?

jp: アクシデントもあったが、エンテュメイシスは倒せた。お前は決戦因子としてよくやってくれたよ。後は俺たちに任せてくれ。
jp_grezzo: "アクシデントもあったが、エンテュメイシスは倒せた。お前は決戦因子としてよくやってくれたよ。後は俺たちに任せてくれ。"
en: It didn't go without a hitch, but what matters is that Enthumesis has been defeated. You can leave the rest to me.
en_grezzo: "It didn't go without a hitch, but what matters is that Enthumesis has been defeated. You can leave the rest to me."
it: Qualche imprevisto c'è stato, ma quel che conta è che Enthumesis è caduto. Il resto lascialo a me.

jp: お前は心配性だな…。大丈夫だ、やつは身体の動かし方すら概念レベルで忘れている。出てこられるわけがない。仮に、外側から出そうとする者が来ても、神の間と物理的につながっているのはこの扉のみ。そしてこの階層は神力が使える。つまりソピアーが常闇の杖で事前に感知してくれるのさ。
jp_grezzo: "お前は心配性だな…。大丈夫だ、やつは身体の動かし方すら概念レベルで忘れている。出てこられるわけがない。仮に、外側から出そうとする者が来ても、神の間と物理的につながっているのはこの扉のみ。そしてこの階層は神力が使える。つまりソピアーが常闇の杖で事前に感知してくれるのさ。"
en: You don't have to worry about that. It can't even move its body properly - there's no chance that it'll get out from here. Even if someone from the outside tried to bring it out, Sophia would know. The door here is the sole entryway into the Eternal Seal, and divine power can be used here perfectly well.
en_grezzo: "You don't have to worry about that. It can't even move its body properly - there's no chance that it'll get out from here. Even if someone from the outside tried to bring it out, Sophia would know. The door here is the sole entryway into the Eternal Seal, and divine power can be used here perfectly well."
it: Ti preoccupi troppo... Tranquillo, quello non ricorda nemmeno più come si muove un corpo: non ha modo di uscire. E se qualcuno da fuori provasse a tirarlo fuori, Sophia se ne accorgerebbe: questa porta è l'unico passaggio fisico verso il Sigillo Eterno, e qui il potere divino funziona.

jp: 警備は完璧だ。お前はいつもの生活に戻ってくれ。
jp_grezzo: "警備は完璧だ。お前はいつもの生活に戻ってくれ。"
en: I'll take care of guarding this place. You can go back to your normal life now.
en_grezzo: "I'll take care of guarding this place. You can go back to your normal life now."
it: Alla guardia ci penso io, e la faccio bene. Tu torna alla tua vita di sempre.

jp: ああ
jp_grezzo: "ああ"
en: Yes.
it: Sì.

jp: いや…
jp_grezzo: "いや…"
en: No...
it: Meglio di no...

jp: 来たな。イベントの続きをやるぞ。本来はエンテュメイシスを倒した直後にそのまま起きるものだからな。
jp_grezzo: "来たな。イベントの続きをやるぞ。本来はエンテュメイシスを倒した直後にそのまま起きるものだからな。"
en: You're back. Let's get on with the rest of the event. This was supposed to happen immediately after defeating Enthumesis.
en_grezzo: "You're back. Let's get on with the rest of the event. This was supposed to happen immediately after defeating Enthumesis."
it: Eccoti. Andiamo avanti con l'evento: in teoria doveva partire subito dopo la caduta di Enthumesis.

jp: 神の間に行くか？
jp_grezzo: "神の間に行くか？"
en: Head down to the Eternal Seal?
it: Scendiamo nel Sigillo Eterno?

jp: 次は何をすればいい？
jp_grezzo: "次は何をすればいい？"
en: What do I have to do next?
en_grezzo: "What do I have to do next?"
it: Adesso che devo fare?

jp: それ知ってた
jp_grezzo: "それ知ってた"
en: I knew that already.
it: Lo sapevo già.

jp: テスカトリポカが混沌の神じゃないの？
jp_grezzo: "テスカトリポカが混沌の神じゃないの？"
en: Isn't Tezcatlipoca the God of Chaos?
it: Tezcatlipoca non è il dio del caos?

jp: 勝ったご褒美は？
jp_grezzo: "勝ったご褒美は？"
en: What do I get if we win?
en_grezzo: "What do I get if we win?"
it: La ricompensa se vinco?

jp: もうちょっと待ってて
jp_grezzo: "もうちょっと待ってて"
en: Hang on a sec.
it: Aspetta ancora un po'.

jp: 【神の間へ降りる】
jp_grezzo: "【神の間へ降りる】"
en: <Head down to the Eternal Seal>
it: <Scendere nel Sigillo Eterno>

jp: それにしても我…いや俺がテスカトリポカだとは思わなかっただろう。騙されたな？
jp_grezzo: "それにしても我…いや俺がテスカトリポカだとは思わなかっただろう。騙されたな？"
en: You didn't think I was Tezcatlipoca, did you? Gotcha.
en_grezzo: "You didn't think I was Tezcatlipoca, did you? Gotcha."
it: Non pensavi che Tezcatlipoca fossi io, eh? Fregato.

jp: 神の間で決戦因子と共に戦えるように、受肉して神力を使わず純粋に鍛え上げた…それがこのレオルドとしての姿だ。混沌の神にどこまで通用するかはわからんがな。
jp_grezzo: "神の間で決戦因子と共に戦えるように、受肉して神力を使わず純粋に鍛え上げた…それがこのレオルドとしての姿だ。混沌の神にどこまで通用するかはわからんがな。"
en: What you see here - the person you call Leold - is a physical form that I had created and trained up without any use of divine power. All so that I could fight alongside the Decisive Factor in the Eternal Seal. I don't know how much of that effort will pay off against the God of Chaos though.
en_grezzo: "What you see here - the person you call Leold - is a physical form that I had created and trained up without any use of divine power. All so that I could fight alongside the Decisive Factor in the Eternal Seal. I don't know how much of that effort will pay off against the God of Chaos though."
it: Quello che vedi, la persona che chiami Leold, è un corpo che mi sono fatto e che ho allenato senza mai usare il potere divino. Tutto per poter combattere al fianco del Fattore Decisivo nel Sigillo Eterno. Quanto servirà contro il dio del caos, però, non lo so.

jp: ソピアーが中心になって決戦準備を進めている。準備ができ次第、神の間に突入してもらうことになるだろう。気になるなら進捗を確認しに行ってくれ。
jp_grezzo: "ソピアーが中心になって決戦準備を進めている。準備ができ次第、神の間に突入してもらうことになるだろう。気になるなら進捗を確認しに行ってくれ。"
en: Sophia and the others are preparing for the final confrontation. You're probably going to have to fight in the Eternal Seal when the time comes. You can go check to see if how they're doing with the preparations if you want.
en_grezzo: "Sophia and the others are preparing for the final confrontation. You're probably going to have to fight in the Eternal Seal when the time comes. You can go check to see if how they're doing with the preparations if you want."
it: Sophia e gli altri stanno preparando lo scontro decisivo. Quando saranno pronti toccherà a te scendere nel Sigillo Eterno. Se ti interessa, va' a vedere a che punto sono.

jp: う、嘘だろ？
jp_grezzo: "う、嘘だろ？"
en: You... you're kidding...
it: M-ma dai, scherzi?

jp: ネタバレしたのは誰だ。…シナアか！？
jp_grezzo: "ネタバレしたのは誰だ。…シナアか！？"
en: Who let the cat out of the bag?! Was it Sinaha?!
en_grezzo: "Who let the cat out of the bag?! Was it Sinaha?!"
it: Chi è che ha vuotato il sacco?! ...Sinaha?!

jp: シナア「うみゃっ！？」
jp_grezzo: "シナア「うみゃっ！？」"
en: Sinaha: \"Mew!?\"
it: Sinaha: \"Miao?!\"

jp: 誰がそんなこと言ったんだ。混沌の神は混沌の神、テスカトリポカはテスカトリポカで全くの別神だぞ。誰かの推測でも鵜呑みにしたか？
jp_grezzo: "誰がそんなこと言ったんだ。混沌の神は混沌の神、テスカトリポカはテスカトリポカで全くの別神だぞ。誰かの推測でも鵜呑みにしたか？"
en: Who told you that? The God of Chaos and Tezcatlipoca are completely different beings. You shouldn't believe every rumour that you hear.
en_grezzo: "Who told you that? The God of Chaos and Tezcatlipoca are completely different beings. You shouldn't believe every rumour that you hear."
it: Chi te l'ha detto? Il dio del caos è il dio del caos e Tezcatlipoca è Tezcatlipoca: due divinità del tutto diverse. Non bere ogni voce che ti arriva.

jp: 俺は滅亡が迫っていることを決戦因子候補たちに警告し、神の間を目指して必要な力を示すように指示したが…俺自身が滅ぼすなんて一言も言っていないだろう。そもそも神の間に囚われていたら神力で外界に呼びかけること自体が不可能だ。
jp_grezzo: "俺は滅亡が迫っていることを決戦因子候補たちに警告し、神の間を目指して必要な力を示すように指示したが…俺自身が滅ぼすなんて一言も言っていないだろう。そもそも神の間に囚われていたら神力で外界に呼びかけること自体が不可能だ。"
en: When danger drew close, I did warn all the people who were candidates for the Decisive Factor and tell them to head to the Eternal Seal. I did not say anything about destroying anything myself, did I? Besides, it would've been impossible to summon anybody in the outside world if I were trapped in the Prison.
en_grezzo: "When danger drew close, I did warn all the people who were candidates for the Decisive Factor and tell them to head to the Eternal Seal. I did not say anything about destroying anything myself, did I? Besides, it would've been impossible to summon anybody in the outside world if I were trapped in the Prison."
it: Quando la rovina si è avvicinata ho avvertito tutti i candidati a Fattore Decisivo e gli ho detto di puntare al Sigillo Eterno. Ma di distruggere io qualcosa non ho mai detto una parola, o sbaglio? E poi, se fossi stato prigioniero là dentro, chiamare qualcuno nel mondo di fuori col potere divino sarebbe stato impossibile.

jp: 確定情報と不確定情報は混同せず、ちゃんと分けて整理したほうがいいぞ。勘違いを招くからな。
jp_grezzo: "確定情報と不確定情報は混同せず、ちゃんと分けて整理したほうがいいぞ。勘違いを招くからな。"
en: You should always be careful about separating facts from assumptions, or else you'll get things wrong again.
en_grezzo: "You should always be careful about separating facts from assumptions, or else you'll get things wrong again."
it: Fa' sempre attenzione a separare quel che è certo da quel che è supposto, o continuerai a prendere abbagli.

jp: 神の間では記録ができないらしい。回復アイテム、補給用アイテム、装備の見直…いや、前にも言ったからもう分かっているか。
jp_grezzo: "神の間では記録ができないらしい。回復アイテム、補給用アイテム、装備の見直…いや、前にも言ったからもう分かっているか。"
en: It looks like you're not going to be able to save while you're inside there. Do you have all your healing and buffing items? What about your equipment? ...No, I think I've told you all that already, haven't I?
en_grezzo: "It looks like you're not going to be able to save while you're inside there. Do you have all your healing and buffing items? What about your equipment? ...No, I think I've told you all that already, haven't I?"
it: Pare che là dentro non si possa registrare la partita. Hai gli oggetti di cura, quelli di rifornimento, l'equipaggiamento in ordi... no, te l'ho già detto, lo sai di sicuro.

jp: 混沌の神エンテュメイシス討伐。ついにこの時が来た。よし…俺も覚悟を決めたぞ。行こう、！
jp_grezzo: "混沌の神エンテュメイシス討伐。ついにこの時が来た。よし…俺も覚悟を決めたぞ。行こう、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！"
en: The time to defeat Enthumesis has finally come. Alright. I think I'm ready too. Let's go, !
en_grezzo: "The time to defeat Enthumesis has finally come. Alright. I think I'm ready too. Let's go, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "!"
contesto: chatMore lang("混沌の神エンテュメイシス討伐。ついにこの時が来た。よし…俺も覚悟を決めたぞ。行こう、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！", "The time to defeat Enthumesis has finally come. Alright. I think I'm ready too. Let's go, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "!")
it: "È giunto il momento di abbattere Enthumesis. Bene... anch'io sono pronto. Andiamo, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "!"

jp: 褒美か。アーティファクトなら戦闘で落としたものを持っていけ。
jp_grezzo: "褒美か。アーティファクトなら戦闘で落としたものを持っていけ。"
en: A reward? You can have this artifact that it dropped.
en_grezzo: "A reward? You can have this artifact that it dropped."
it: Una ricompensa? Prendi l'artefatto che ha lasciato cadere.

jp: 宝玉も渡しただろう？覚醒の宝玉だ。
jp_grezzo: "宝玉も渡しただろう？覚醒の宝玉だ。"
en: I gave you a gem, right? The gemstone of awakening.
en_grezzo: "I gave you a gem, right? The gemstone of awakening."
it: Una gemma te l'ho già data, no? Il Risveglio di Nefia.

jp: 保留
jp_grezzo: "保留"
en: Maybe later.
it: Più avanti.

jp: 全部だ！
jp_grezzo: "全部だ！"
en: I want all of them!
it: Li voglio tutti!

jp: あとは化身の1体くらいならくれてやってもいいがどうする？爪の鋭い奴と牙がすごい奴がいるんだが。
jp_grezzo: "あとは化身の1体くらいならくれてやってもいいがどうする？爪の鋭い奴と牙がすごい奴がいるんだが。"
en: You can have one more servant. How 'bout it? There are ones with sharp talons and some with really impressive teeth.
en_grezzo: "You can have one more servant. How 'bout it? There are ones with sharp talons and some with really impressive teeth."
it: Un'altra incarnazione te la posso dare, che ne dici? Ce n'è con gli artigli affilati e ce n'è con certe zanne...

jp: そうか…。あと言っておくが、俺は光玉は持ってないからな。
jp_grezzo: "そうか…。あと言っておくが、俺は光玉は持ってないからな。"
en: Okay then. And just so that you know, I don't have any god jewels.
en_grezzo: "Okay then. And just so that you know, I don't have any god jewels."
it: Va bene... E te lo dico: gioielli divini io non ne ho.

jp: 欲張りだな。混沌の神を討伐したらもう1体くれてやるから勘弁してくれ。
jp_grezzo: "欲張りだな。混沌の神を討伐したらもう1体くれてやるから勘弁してくれ。"
en: Greedy, aren't you? I'll give you just one more after we defeat the God of Chaos, okay?
en_grezzo: "Greedy, aren't you? I'll give you just one more after we defeat the God of Chaos, okay?"
it: Che ingordigia. Quando avremo abbattuto il dio del caos te ne do un'altra, e per adesso accontentati.

jp: ここで何してるの？
jp_grezzo: "ここで何してるの？"
en: What are you doing here?
it: Tu che ci fai qui?

jp: 二番乗りじゃなくて？
jp_grezzo: "二番乗りじゃなくて？"
en: First? I'm not the second?
it: Davvero? Nessuno prima di me?

jp: よくここまで辿り着いたな。、お前が一番乗りだ。
jp_grezzo: "よくここまで辿り着いたな。" + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "、お前が一番乗りだ。"
en: Good to see you here,  . You're the first one to arrive.
en_grezzo: "Good to see you here, " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + " " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". You're the first one to arrive."
contesto: buff = lang("よくここまで辿り着いたな。" + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "、お前が一番乗りだ。", "Good to see you here, " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + " " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". You're the first one to arrive.")
it: "Bella impresa. " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + ": qui prima di te non era arrivato nessuno."

jp: 俺は決戦因子の選定役だ。ずっと伏せてきたが、これが八柱神から与えられた使命でな。そのために強者の育成に力を尽くしてきた。
jp_grezzo: "俺は決戦因子の選定役だ。ずっと伏せてきたが、これが八柱神から与えられた使命でな。そのために強者の育成に力を尽くしてきた。"
en: I'm the one who selects the Decisive Factor. I've kept this a secret for a long time, but this is the mission given to me by the Eight Pillars. That is the reason I've been devoting myself to training the strong.
en_grezzo: "I'm the one who selects the Decisive Factor. I've kept this a secret for a long time, but this is the mission given to me by the Eight Pillars. That is the reason I've been devoting myself to training the strong."
it: Sono io che scelgo il Fattore Decisivo. L'ho tenuto nascosto a lungo, ma è la missione che mi hanno affidato le otto divinità. Per questo mi sono dedicato ad allenare i forti.

jp: しかし、まさか初対面の冒険者が来るとはな。俺の立場がないぞ…。
jp_grezzo: "しかし、まさか初対面の冒険者が来るとはな。俺の立場がないぞ…。"
en: But to think that an adventurer that I've never met before would be here... Impressive. You've put my efforts to shame.
en_grezzo: "But to think that an adventurer that I've never met before would be here... Impressive. You've put my efforts to shame."
it: Però non mi aspettavo di trovarci qualcuno che non avevo mai incontrato... Notevole. La mia fatica ne esce sminuita.

jp: すぐ下が神の間に続いている。神の間では記録ができないらしい。回復アイテム、補給用アイテム、装備の見直し、メンバーの入れ替え…入念に準備をするんだ。用意ができたら話しかけてくれ、案内する。
jp_grezzo: "すぐ下が神の間に続いている。神の間では記録ができないらしい。回復アイテム、補給用アイテム、装備の見直し、メンバーの入れ替え…入念に準備をするんだ。用意ができたら話しかけてくれ、案内する。"
en: The Eternal Seal is right ahead. I've heard that you won't be able to save in there. Make sure that you have all your healing and buffing items, and give your equipment and party a lookover. You can't be over-prepared for what's ahead. When you're ready, come talk to me and I'll take you there.
en_grezzo: "The Eternal Seal is right ahead. I've heard that you won't be able to save in there. Make sure that you have all your healing and buffing items, and give your equipment and party a lookover. You can't be over-prepared for what's ahead. When you're ready, come talk to me and I'll take you there."
it: Subito sotto comincia il Sigillo Eterno. Pare che là dentro non si possa registrare la partita. Controlla gli oggetti di cura e di rifornimento, rivedi l'equipaggiamento, cambia i compagni se serve: preparati con cura. Quando hai finito, parlami e ti accompagno.

jp: 用意してくる
jp_grezzo: "用意してくる"
en: Still making preparations.
it: Mi preparo ancora.

jp: 力の覚醒
jp_grezzo: "力の覚醒"
en: Awaken powers.
it: Risvegliare il potere.

jp: 【テスカトリポカと戦う】
jp_grezzo: "【テスカトリポカと戦う】"
en: <Fight Tezcatlipoca>
it: <Sfidare Tezcatlipoca>

jp: どうした？
jp_grezzo: "どうした？"
en: Yeah?
it: Che c'è?

jp: ここでやると色々と処理が面倒くさくてな。悪いがウールム・レゾンまで来てくれ。
jp_grezzo: "ここでやると色々と処理が面倒くさくてな。悪いがウールム・レゾンまで来てくれ。"
en: That's going to be too much trouble here. If you want that, you'll have to come see me in Ulm-Leson.
en_grezzo: "That's going to be too much trouble here. If you want that, you'll have to come see me in Ulm-Leson."
it: Qui la faccenda è troppo scomoda da gestire. Se ti serve, vieni a trovarmi a Ulm-Leson.

jp: ん？…まぁ、いいだろう。先にテスカトリポカについて話をしておこう。
jp_grezzo: "ん？…まぁ、いいだろう。先にテスカトリポカについて話をしておこう。"
en: Hmm? Well, alright. But first, I should tell you about Tezcatlipoca.
en_grezzo: "Hmm? Well, alright. But first, I should tell you about Tezcatlipoca."
it: Mh? ...E va bene. Ma prima ti dico due cose su Tezcatlipoca.

jp: テスカトリポカは争いを好む軍神だ。元々はエヘカトルやイツパロトルと同じ地域で生まれた神だったらしいが。エヘカトルとは長年の好敵手で、代が変わっても殺し合ったり作ったものを壊し合ったり時に怪物討伐で共闘したりを繰り返してきたとされる。
jp_grezzo: "テスカトリポカは争いを好む軍神だ。元々はエヘカトルやイツパロトルと同じ地域で生まれた神だったらしいが。エヘカトルとは長年の好敵手で、代が変わっても殺し合ったり作ったものを壊し合ったり時に怪物討伐で共闘したりを繰り返してきたとされる。"
en: Tezcatlipoca is the conflict-loving God of War. It's said that he was born in the same domain as Ehekatl and Itzpalt. Forever the rival of Ehekatl, they would fight and kill each other generation after generation, but also fight alongside each other to slay monsters.
en_grezzo: "Tezcatlipoca is the conflict-loving God of War. It's said that he was born in the same domain as Ehekatl and Itzpalt. Forever the rival of Ehekatl, they would fight and kill each other generation after generation, but also fight alongside each other to slay monsters."
it: Tezcatlipoca è il dio della guerra, e le contese gli piacciono. Si dice sia nato nella stessa terra di Ehekatl e Itzpalt. Di Ehekatl è rivale da sempre: generazione dopo generazione si sono ammazzati a vicenda, ma hanno anche combattuto fianco a fianco per abbattere mostri.

jp: 特に初代は狡猾な奴だったらしい。具体的には、初代の男のエヘカトルを騙して特殊な呪われた酒を飲ませ、エヘカトルが悪酔いして実の妹と気持ちいいこと漬けになったところで暴露して追放に追い込んだりな。
jp_grezzo: "特に初代は狡猾な奴だったらしい。具体的には、初代の男のエヘカトルを騙して特殊な呪われた酒を飲ませ、エヘカトルが悪酔いして実の妹と気持ちいいこと漬けになったところで暴露して追放に追い込んだりな。"
en: It's said that the first generation of Tezcatlipoca was extremely cunning. He tricked the first Ehekatl into drinking a special cursed wine and made him have a little tail with his own little sister, then exposed the scandal to exile him.
en_grezzo: "It's said that the first generation of Tezcatlipoca was extremely cunning. He tricked the first Ehekatl into drinking a special cursed wine and made him have a little tail with his own little sister, then exposed the scandal to exile him."
it: Il primo Tezcatlipoca, dicono, era di un'astuzia rara. Ingannò il primo Ehekatl e gli fece bere un vino maledetto: quando quello, ubriaco fradicio, finì a letto con la propria sorella minore, lo smascherò e lo fece mandare in esilio.

jp: とにかく油断をするなということだ。単純な戦闘力だけではなく、騙されるという危険があるのだから。では、いくぞ。
jp_grezzo: "とにかく油断をするなということだ。単純な戦闘力だけではなく、騙されるという危険があるのだから。では、いくぞ。"
en: Anyway, you just have to be careful of him. Tezcatlipoca isn't just about combat prowess - you also have to be careful not to get tricked. Now, let's go.
en_grezzo: "Anyway, you just have to be careful of him. Tezcatlipoca isn't just about combat prowess - you also have to be careful not to get tricked. Now, let's go."
it: Insomma: non abbassare la guardia. Con Tezcatlipoca non è solo questione di forza in battaglia, c'è anche il rischio di farsi ingannare. Bene, andiamo.

jp: いいか、お前は強い。その辺りの雑魚では相手にならず、戦いに飢え、取り返しのつかないことをしてしまう日がいつか来るかもしれない。…こいつを渡しておく。
jp_grezzo: "いいか" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "、お前は強い。その辺りの雑魚では相手にならず、戦いに飢え、取り返しのつかないことをしてしまう日がいつか来るかもしれない。…こいつを渡しておく。"
en: You're strong, . The time may come when monsters are no longer any match for you and you lust to fight something stronger. When that time comes, use this.
en_grezzo: "You're strong, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". The time may come when monsters are no longer any match for you and you lust to fight something stronger. When that time comes, use this."
contesto: chatMore lang("いいか" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "、お前は強い。その辺りの雑魚では相手にならず、戦いに飢え、取り返しのつかないことをしてしまう日がいつか来るかもしれない。…こいつを渡しておく。", "You're strong, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". The time may come when monsters are no longer any match for you and you lust to fight something stronger. When that time comes, use this.")
it: "Sei forte, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". Verrà il giorno in cui nessun mostro sarà più all'altezza e ti prenderà la fame di battaglia. Quando arriva, usa questa."

jp: その宝玉は近辺のネフィアを活性化させ、内部のモンスターの力を引き出すことができる。役に立つかはわからんが、副次効果としてネフィアの核も手に入れることができるだろう。
jp_grezzo: "その宝玉は近辺のネフィアを活性化させ、内部のモンスターの力を引き出すことができる。役に立つかはわからんが、副次効果としてネフィアの核も手に入れることができるだろう。"
en: This gem awakens nearby Nefia and brings out the potential of the monsters within them. It also enables you to find the core of Nefia - though I don't know if you'll have any use for those.
en_grezzo: "This gem awakens nearby Nefia and brings out the potential of the monsters within them. It also enables you to find the core of Nefia - though I don't know if you'll have any use for those."
it: Questa gemma risveglia le Nefia dei dintorni e tira fuori tutta la forza dei mostri che ci vivono. Ti fa trovare anche il nucleo di Nefia, anche se non so quanto ti possa servire.

jp: …言っておくが、お前だけにこれを渡しているわけではないからな。勘違いするなよ。
jp_grezzo: "…言っておくが、お前だけにこれを渡しているわけではないからな。勘違いするなよ。"
en: Don't think you're the only one I've given this to, though. Because you're not.
en_grezzo: "Don't think you're the only one I've given this to, though. Because you're not."
it: ...Che sia chiaro, non l'ho data solo a te. Non montarti la testa.

jp: …！なかなかいい面構えをしている。こんな強者と今まで巡り会えなかったとは、俺もついていなかったな。
jp_grezzo: "…！なかなかいい面構えをしている。こんな強者と今まで巡り会えなかったとは、俺もついていなかったな。"
en: You! You've got the look of someone strong. Just my luck that it would take me this long to meet someone as strong as you.
en_grezzo: "You! You've got the look of someone strong. Just my luck that it would take me this long to meet someone as strong as you."
it: Ehi! Hai la faccia di chi sa combattere. Non avevo ancora incrociato nessuno della tua forza: che sfortuna la mia.

jp: 名前は…そうか、というのか。お前がこの地で生き延び強くなれるよう、少し助力をしてやろう。
jp_grezzo: "名前は…そうか、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "というのか。お前がこの地で生き延び強くなれるよう、少し助力をしてやろう。"
en: Your name is...? ? I see. Well then, , I can lend you a hand if you want so that you can survive in these lands.
en_grezzo: "Your name is...? " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "? I see. Well then, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", I can lend you a hand if you want so that you can survive in these lands."
contesto: chatMore lang("名前は…そうか、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "というのか。お前がこの地で生き延び強くなれるよう、少し助力をしてやろう。", "Your name is...? " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "? I see. Well then, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", I can lend you a hand if you want so that you can survive in these lands.")
it: "Il nome...? " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "? Ah, capisco. E allora, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", ti do una mano: così in questa terra sopravvivi e ti fai più forte."

jp: そうそう。強者といえば、銀熊という異名の冒険者は特に見込みがあったんだが、止めるのも聞かずに大陸中央の巨城に乗り込んでしまった。いくら強くても人の話を聞かないやつは駄目だな。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう。強者といえば、銀熊という異名の冒険者は特に見込みがあったんだが、止めるのも聞かずに大陸中央の巨城に乗り込んでしまった。いくら強くても人の話を聞かないやつは駄目だな。"
en: Speaking of strong, I saw a particularly promising adventurer called the Silver Bear. But she completely ignored me and headed straight into the Cradle of Chaos at the centre of the continent. Strength isn't going to make up for that lack of attention to others.
en_grezzo: "Speaking of strong, I saw a particularly promising adventurer called the Silver Bear. But she completely ignored me and headed straight into the Cradle of Chaos at the centre of the continent. Strength isn't going to make up for that lack of attention to others."
it: A proposito di forza: c'era un'avventuriera che si faceva chiamare l'orsa d'argento, e prometteva parecchio. Ma non mi ha dato retta ed è andata dritta nella Culla del Caos, al centro del continente. Per quanto uno sia forte, se non ascolta gli altri non vale niente.

jp: こっちに来てから、お前にまた会える日を待っていたぞ。他にも見込みのある冒険者が数名いたが…どうもな。
jp_grezzo: "こっちに来てから、お前にまた会える日を待っていたぞ。他にも見込みのある冒険者が数名いたが…どうもな。"
en: I've been waiting for you ever since I got here. There are a few other promising adventurers, but well...
en_grezzo: "I've been waiting for you ever since I got here. There are a few other promising adventurers, but well..."
it: Da quando sono qui aspettavo di rivederti. Avventurieri promettenti ce n'erano altri, ma... insomma.

jp: 銀熊という異名の冒険者は特に見込みがあったんだが、俺の話も聞かずに大陸中央の巨城に乗り込んでしまった。いくら強くても人の話を聞かないやつは駄目だな。
jp_grezzo: "銀熊という異名の冒険者は特に見込みがあったんだが、俺の話も聞かずに大陸中央の巨城に乗り込んでしまった。いくら強くても人の話を聞かないやつは駄目だな。"
en: There was one called the Silver Bear, but she completely ignored me and headed straight into the Cradle of Chaos at the centre of the continent. Strength isn't going to make up for that lack of attention to others.
en_grezzo: "There was one called the Silver Bear, but she completely ignored me and headed straight into the Cradle of Chaos at the centre of the continent. Strength isn't going to make up for that lack of attention to others."
it: Ce n'era una che si faceva chiamare l'orsa d'argento, e prometteva parecchio. Ma non ha dato retta neanche a me ed è andata dritta nella Culla del Caos, al centro del continente. Per quanto uno sia forte, se non ascolta gli altri non vale niente.

jp: …！なかなかいい面構えをしている。俺の見込み違いでなければ、お前は相当強くなれそうだ。
jp_grezzo: "…！なかなかいい面構えをしている。俺の見込み違いでなければ、お前は相当強くなれそうだ。"
en: You! You've got the look of someone strong. And if I'm not wrong about you, you're going to get really strong.
en_grezzo: "You! You've got the look of someone strong. And if I'm not wrong about you, you're going to get really strong."
it: Ehi! Hai la faccia di chi sa combattere. E se non mi sbaglio sul tuo conto, puoi diventare davvero forte.

jp: おお、お前もこっちに来てたのか。修行したいなら大陸中央にある遺跡がお勧めだぞ。メルガスに駐屯しているイェルス軍が管理していて入れないかもしれないがな。
jp_grezzo: "おお" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "、お前もこっちに来てたのか。修行したいなら大陸中央にある遺跡がお勧めだぞ。メルガスに駐屯しているイェルス軍が管理していて入れないかもしれないがな。"
en: Ah, , I see you're here too. If you want to train yourself, you should try the Nefia in the center of the continent. But you might not be able to get in because the Yerles army stationed at Melugas have it locked down.
en_grezzo: "Ah, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", I see you're here too. If you want to train yourself, you should try the Nefia in the center of the continent. But you might not be able to get in because the Yerles army stationed at Melugas have it locked down."
contesto: chatMore lang("おお" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "、お前もこっちに来てたのか。修行したいなら大陸中央にある遺跡がお勧めだぞ。メルガスに駐屯しているイェルス軍が管理していて入れないかもしれないがな。", "Ah, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", I see you're here too. If you want to train yourself, you should try the Nefia in the center of the continent. But you might not be able to get in because the Yerles army stationed at Melugas have it locked down.")
it: "Ah, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", ci sei anche tu da queste parti. Se vuoi allenarti, prova le Nefia al centro del continente. Anche se forse non ci entri: l'esercito Yerles di stanza a Melugas le tiene sotto chiave."

jp: 今はいい
jp_grezzo: "今はいい"
en: I'm okay for now.
it: Non adesso

jp_grezzo: "冒険の知恵"

it: Consigli d'avventura

jp_grezzo: "力の覚醒"

it: Risvegliare il potere.

jp_grezzo: "目標が欲しい"

it: Voglio un obiettivo.

jp: 目標を達成した
jp_grezzo: "目標を達成した"

it: Obiettivo raggiunto.

jp: 現状に甘んじることなく、心と体を鍛え更なる高みを目指すのだ。何か俺に手伝えることはあるか？
jp_grezzo: "現状に甘んじることなく、心と体を鍛え更なる高みを目指すのだ。何か俺に手伝えることはあるか？"
en: Never grow complacent - always strive to train your body and mind to reach new heights. Anything I can do to help?
en_grezzo: "Never grow complacent - always strive to train your body and mind to reach new heights. Anything I can do to help?"
it: Non accontentarti mai di dove sei: allena il corpo e la mente e punta sempre più in alto. C'è qualcosa in cui ti posso aiutare?

jp_grezzo: "食料について"

it: Il cibo.

jp_grezzo: "仲間について"

it: I compagni.

jp_grezzo: "アイテムについて"

it: Gli oggetti.

jp_grezzo: "生活について"

it: La vita quotidiana.

jp_grezzo: "その他"

it: Altro.

jp: 聞きたいことはどれだ？
jp_grezzo: "聞きたいことはどれだ？"
en: What would you like to know about?
en_grezzo: "What would you like to know about?"
it: Su che cosa vuoi sapere?

jp: 成長にいいのはハーブや出来のいい料理だ。だがどうしても食料に困ったら、ワールドマップ上の平原でマップに入り野草や実を拾うといいだろう。ちなみに宿屋での食事は安価で腹いっぱい食えるが栄養はないからな。
jp_grezzo: "成長にいいのはハーブや出来のいい料理だ。だがどうしても食料に困ったら、ワールドマップ上の平原でマップに入り野草や実を拾うといいだろう。ちなみに宿屋での食事は安価で腹いっぱい食えるが栄養はないからな。"
en: Herbs and well-cooked dishes are great for attribute growth. If you're having trouble finding food though, try entering an empty area from the world map and looking for wild plants or fruit. Oh, and by the way. While you can get a cheap and satiating meal from any inn, those meals provide no nourishment whatsoever.
en_grezzo: "Herbs and well-cooked dishes are great for attribute growth. If you're having trouble finding food though, try entering an empty area from the world map and looking for wild plants or fruit. Oh, and by the way. While you can get a cheap and satiating meal from any inn, those meals provide no nourishment whatsoever."
it: Per far crescere le caratteristiche vanno bene le erbe e i piatti cucinati come si deve. Se proprio non trovi da mangiare, entra in una pianura dalla mappa del mondo e raccogli erbe selvatiche e frutti. Ah, e a proposito: alla locanda si mangia a poco e ci si riempie la pancia, ma quel cibo non nutre per niente.

jp: ただしパンや旅糧、アピの実や芋などの一部を除いて食べ物は大体腐る。無理に腐ったものや呪われたものを食べても、吐いて余計に腹が減るし体も弱るぞ。
jp_grezzo: "ただしパンや旅糧、アピの実や芋などの一部を除いて食べ物は大体腐る。無理に腐ったものや呪われたものを食べても、吐いて余計に腹が減るし体も弱るぞ。"
en: Most food will eventually rot, though there are some exceptions such as api nuts, bread, rations, and potatoes.
en_grezzo: "Most food will eventually rot, though there are some exceptions such as api nuts, bread, rations, and potatoes."
it: Quasi tutto il cibo prima o poi marcisce. Fanno eccezione noci di Api, pane, cibo da viaggio e patate.

jp: そして何度も吐いていると拒食症になってしまう。拒食症の間は何を食べても吐いてしまい、飲み物しか喉を通らない。こうなると充分な睡眠をとって自然治療するか、死ぬしかないから気を付けろ。
jp_grezzo: "そして何度も吐いていると拒食症になってしまう。拒食症の間は何を食べても吐いてしまい、飲み物しか喉を通らない。こうなると充分な睡眠をとって自然治療するか、死ぬしかないから気を付けろ。"
en: After vomiting multiple times, you might become anorexic. You'll vomit up anything you eat during that time, so try to get by on liquids. You can cure it naturally by getting enough sleep, but watch out, as the only other way to get rid of it is to die.
en_grezzo: "After vomiting multiple times, you might become anorexic. You'll vomit up anything you eat during that time, so try to get by on liquids. You can cure it naturally by getting enough sleep, but watch out, as the only other way to get rid of it is to die."
it: A furia di vomitare puoi finire nell'anoressia. Finché dura rimetti qualunque cosa mangi, quindi tira avanti a bevande. Si guarisce da sé dormendo a sufficienza, ma attenzione: l'unico altro modo per liberarsene è morire.

jp: 最初は弱い仲間も鍛えればかなり戦力になるぞ。お前の魅力が高くなればより多くの仲間を連れ歩けるだろう。
jp_grezzo: "最初は弱い仲間も鍛えればかなり戦力になるぞ。お前の魅力が高くなればより多くの仲間を連れ歩けるだろう。"
en: Although companions might start out pretty weak, with enough training, they can become quit formidable. With a higher Charisma value, you can bring along more companions.
en_grezzo: "Although companions might start out pretty weak, with enough training, they can become quit formidable. With a higher Charisma value, you can bring along more companions."
it: Un compagno può cominciare debole, ma con l'allenamento giusto diventa una forza. E più alto è il tuo carisma, più compagni ti puoi portare dietro.

jp: 仲間を戦闘に参加させるなら、いい食べ物やいいアイテムを渡して強化することは必須だ。ただし鉱石や結婚指輪など、一部のアイテムは渡すと返してもらえないぞ。
jp_grezzo: "仲間を戦闘に参加させるなら、いい食べ物やいいアイテムを渡して強化することは必須だ。ただし鉱石や結婚指輪など、一部のアイテムは渡すと返してもらえないぞ。"
en: If you intend for them to join you in battle, it's essential that you feed your companions good food and give them good equipment. However, if you give them things such as ore and engagement jewelry, you won't be able to get those items back.
en_grezzo: "If you intend for them to join you in battle, it's essential that you feed your companions good food and give them good equipment. However, if you give them things such as ore and engagement jewelry, you won't be able to get those items back."
it: Se vuoi che combattano al tuo fianco, devi per forza dar loro cibo buono ed equipaggiamento buono. Attenzione però: certe cose, come i minerali e gli anelli nuziali, se le dai non te le restituiscono più.

jp: あと、浮遊していない仲間は水を飲もうとして井戸に落ちて死んでしまうことがあるから気をつけろ。死んだり待機している仲間は酒場で復帰させることが出来るから覚えておけ。
jp_grezzo: "あと、浮遊していない仲間は水を飲もうとして井戸に落ちて死んでしまうことがあるから気をつけろ。死んだり待機している仲間は酒場で復帰させることが出来るから覚えておけ。"
en: Also, a companion who can't float may fall to their death when attempting to drink water from a well, so be careful. Keep in mind that you can revive dead pets or retrieve pets on stand-by at any bar.
en_grezzo: "Also, a companion who can't float may fall to their death when attempting to drink water from a well, so be careful. Keep in mind that you can revive dead pets or retrieve pets on stand-by at any bar."
it: E occhio: un compagno che non levita può cadere nel pozzo mentre cerca di bere, e morirci. Ricorda che i compagni morti o rimasti in attesa si recuperano alla taverna.

jp: 鑑定は大事だぞ。知らずに呪われたアイテムを使用するとろくなことにならないからな。特に、呪われた装備を着けると突然テレポートしたり、魔物を呼び寄せてしまったりする。他人が呪われた装備をしている場合は解呪の巻物を渡したり解呪の杖を振ったりするといいだろう。
jp_grezzo: "鑑定は大事だぞ。知らずに呪われたアイテムを使用するとろくなことにならないからな。特に、呪われた装備を着けると突然テレポートしたり、魔物を呼び寄せてしまったりする。他人が呪われた装備をしている場合は解呪の巻物を渡したり解呪の杖を振ったりするといいだろう。"
en: It's important that you get items appraised. Otherwise, you may end up using items that are cursed without even realizing it. Wearing equipment that is cursed may cause you to teleport randomly or summon monsters. When others are wearing cursed equipment, you may way to give them a scroll of uncurse or use a rod of uncurse on them to uncurse the equipment.
en_grezzo: "It's important that you get items appraised. Otherwise, you may end up using items that are cursed without even realizing it. Wearing equipment that is cursed may cause you to teleport randomly or summon monsters. When others are wearing cursed equipment, you may way to give them a scroll of uncurse or use a rod of uncurse on them to uncurse the equipment."
it: Identificare gli oggetti è importante: altrimenti finisci per usare roba maledetta senza accorgertene. Un equipaggiamento maledetto ti può teletrasportare all'improvviso o richiamare mostri. Se è un altro a portarlo, dagli una pergamena di purificazione o usagli addosso una bacchetta di purificazione.

jp: 火炎属性・冷気属性の攻撃を受けると、持っているアイテムの一部が破壊されることがある。それと耐酸処理がされていない装備は酸属性のダメージで劣化することがある。防ぐには対応したアイテムが必要だ。前者は耐性を整えることでも防げるがな。
jp_grezzo: "火炎属性・冷気属性の攻撃を受けると、持っているアイテムの一部が破壊されることがある。それと耐酸処理がされていない装備は酸属性のダメージで劣化することがある。防ぐには対応したアイテムが必要だ。前者は耐性を整えることでも防げるがな。"
en: When you take fire or ice damage, some of your items may be destroyed. The integrity of equipment that isn't acid resistant may be damaged when you take acid damage. It's important that you obtain the items needed to stop this from happening. The former can be stopped with resistances alone, though.
en_grezzo: "When you take fire or ice damage, some of your items may be destroyed. The integrity of equipment that isn't acid resistant may be damaged when you take acid damage. It's important that you obtain the items needed to stop this from happening. The former can be stopped with resistances alone, though."
it: Quando prendi danni di fuoco o di freddo, qualche oggetto ti si può distruggere. E l'equipaggiamento senza trattamento antiacido si rovina con i danni d'acido. Per evitarlo servono gli oggetti giusti, anche se contro i primi bastano le resistenze.

jp: 祝福された水を調合（Bキー）でアイテムに使用すると、使用されたアイテムが呪われていても祝福されたアイテムに変化するぞ。祝福されたアイテムは大抵強化されるが、効果が変わらないものもある。装備アイテムならば素材変化させるアイテムを使うと基本性能が大きく変わるぞ。冒険するならば、アイテムもいいものを揃えたいところだな。
jp_grezzo: "祝福された水を調合（Bキー）でアイテムに使用すると、使用されたアイテムが呪われていても祝福されたアイテムに変化するぞ。祝福されたアイテムは大抵強化されるが、効果が変わらないものもある。装備アイテムならば素材変化させるアイテムを使うと基本性能が大きく変わるぞ。冒険するならば、アイテムもいいものを揃えたいところだな。"
en: When you Mix(B key) blessed water it turns an item into a blessed one even if it's cursed. Most of the time blessed items are stronger, but some things don't change. If you use a change material item on an piece of equipment the base stats change. If you're going to travel, best to find good stuff to use.
en_grezzo: "When you Mix(B key) blessed water it turns an item into a blessed one even if it's cursed. Most of the time blessed items are stronger, but some things don't change. If you use a change material item on an piece of equipment the base stats change. If you're going to travel, best to find good stuff to use."
it: Se usi l'acqua benedetta con Mescola (tasto B) su un oggetto, quello diventa benedetto anche se era maledetto. Di solito è più forte, ma qualcosa non cambia. E un cambio di materiale su un pezzo d'equipaggiamento ne cambia le caratteristiche di base. Se vai all'avventura, procurati roba buona.

jp: 外に出て＊キーで辺りを見回してみろ。大体の地形は感じ取れるはずだ。大抵の街や施設では定期的に掃除と維持修復が行われている。長くアイテムを置いておくと片づけられてしまうから注意しろ。逆に、破壊するともう元に戻らない施設もあるから慎重にな。
jp_grezzo: "外に出て＊キーで辺りを見回してみろ。大体の地形は感じ取れるはずだ。大抵の街や施設では定期的に掃除と維持修復が行われている。長くアイテムを置いておくと片づけられてしまうから注意しろ。逆に、破壊するともう元に戻らない施設もあるから慎重にな。"
en: Press the * key on the outer world map. You can get a feel for your surroundings. Towns that have government boards are cleaned and repaired at intervals. You'll lose items you leave laying around for too long. Other places, like this one, on the other hand... they won't be fixed if you destroy them.
en_grezzo: "Press the * key on the outer world map. You can get a feel for your surroundings. Towns that have government boards are cleaned and repaired at intervals. You'll lose items you leave laying around for too long. Other places, like this one, on the other hand... they won't be fixed if you destroy them."
it: Sulla mappa esterna premi il tasto * e guardati intorno: ti fai un'idea di com'è fatto il terreno. Le città con la bacheca pubblica vengono ripulite e riparate a intervalli, e gli oggetti lasciati in giro troppo a lungo li perdi. Altri posti invece, come questo, se li distruggi non li ripara nessuno.

jp: 街や演奏会場にはカジノ系アイテムが置いてあることがある。これを使うとブラックジャックをプレイ出来るぞ。景品に「エーテル抗体のポーション」など貴重なアイテムがあるが、ディーラーは手強い。相当な運かイカサマ技術がなければ苦戦するだろうな。
jp_grezzo: "街や演奏会場にはカジノ系アイテムが置いてあることがある。これを使うとブラックジャックをプレイ出来るぞ。景品に「エーテル抗体のポーション」など貴重なアイテムがあるが、ディーラーは手強い。相当な運かイカサマ技術がなければ苦戦するだろうな。"
en: There are Casino related items in towns and party halls. If you use this you can play some blackjack. You can win prizes like potions of cure corruption but the dealer is tough. It'll be a tough going without a lot of luck or cheating.
en_grezzo: "There are Casino related items in towns and party halls. If you use this you can play some blackjack. You can win prizes like potions of cure corruption but the dealer is tough. It'll be a tough going without a lot of luck or cheating."
it: Nelle città e nelle sale concerti capita di trovare oggetti da casinò. Con quelli puoi giocare a blackjack. Fra i premi ci sono cose preziose come la pozione di cura della corruzione, ma il banco è tosto: senza una gran fortuna o qualche trucco, sudi.

jp: 街では依頼を受けられるが、アイテムが揃うまでは討伐依頼は避け、他の簡単な依頼を受けるのが賢明だろう。ちなみに配達依頼は簡単だが失敗すると大きな罪に問われる。期限に気をつけることだ。罪を負うと負のカルマが蓄積していき、-31になる頃には指名手配されているだろう。
jp_grezzo: "街では依頼を受けられるが、アイテムが揃うまでは討伐依頼は避け、他の簡単な依頼を受けるのが賢明だろう。ちなみに配達依頼は簡単だが失敗すると大きな罪に問われる。期限に気をつけることだ。罪を負うと負のカルマが蓄積していき、-31になる頃には指名手配されているだろう。"
en: You can take up quests in towns, but I recommend you to pass on the extermination quests until you have better gear and just do the simple quests. Delivery quests are easy by the way, but failing incurs big penalties. Be careful of the time limit. The more crimes you commit the lower your Karma goes, you'll be a wanted criminal if it goes below -31.
en_grezzo: "You can take up quests in towns, but I recommend you to pass on the extermination quests until you have better gear and just do the simple quests. Delivery quests are easy by the way, but failing incurs big penalties. Be careful of the time limit. The more crimes you commit the lower your Karma goes, you'll be a wanted criminal if it goes below -31."
it: Nelle città si accettano incarichi, ma finché non hai un equipaggiamento decente lascia perdere quelli di caccia e prendi i più semplici. Le consegne, per dire, sono facili, ma se le fallisci la paghi cara: occhio alla scadenza. Ogni crimine ti abbassa il karma, e sotto il -31 sei ricercato.

jp: 基本的に状態異常は時間経過や回復魔法・アイテムで少しずつ治っていく。しかし寄生の場合は毒薬や染料、硫酸を飲めば治療することが出来る。他人が寄生されている場合でも、それらを渡せば自分から飲んでくれるはずだ。脳髄に寄生された場合は毒物を飲んでも無駄なので、神経に直接ダメージを与えて駆除するしかないだろうな…。
jp_grezzo: "基本的に状態異常は時間経過や回復魔法・アイテムで少しずつ治っていく。しかし寄生の場合は毒薬や染料、硫酸を飲めば治療することが出来る。他人が寄生されている場合でも、それらを渡せば自分から飲んでくれるはずだ。脳髄に寄生された場合は毒物を飲んでも無駄なので、神経に直接ダメージを与えて駆除するしかないだろうな…。"
en: Basically, status effects can be restored by either waiting for time to pass or using restorative magic and items to recover bit by bit. Except being impregnated you need to drink poison, dyes or acids to cure it. If others are infect as well, if you give it to them they'll drink it. If the parasite is in the brain, poison would be useless, the only way to get rid of it would be to damage the nerves directly...
en_grezzo: "Basically, status effects can be restored by either waiting for time to pass or using restorative magic and items to recover bit by bit. Except being impregnated you need to drink poison, dyes or acids to cure it. If others are infect as well, if you give it to them they'll drink it. If the parasite is in the brain, poison would be useless, the only way to get rid of it would be to damage the nerves directly..."
it: Di norma le alterazioni di stato passano da sé col tempo, o si curano un po' per volta con magie e oggetti di guarigione. I parassiti no: per quelli devi bere veleno, tintura o acido. Se è un altro a esserne infestato, basta che glieli dai e li beve da sé. E se il parassita sta nel cervello il veleno non serve a niente: l'unico modo è colpire i nervi direttamente...

jp: それと、他の冒険者は俺と違って執念深い。うっかり怒らせると、倒してもマップを変えても出会うたびに襲い掛かってくるだろう。そうなるとアイテムや魔法で変装するしかないぞ。仲が悪いと自宅に放火されたりするらしいな。
jp_grezzo: "それと、他の冒険者は俺と違って執念深い。うっかり怒らせると、倒してもマップを変えても出会うたびに襲い掛かってくるだろう。そうなるとアイテムや魔法で変装するしかないぞ。仲が悪いと自宅に放火されたりするらしいな。"
en: Also, unlike me, other Adventurers are vicious. If you somehow make them angry, they'll still come after you even after defeating them or changing maps. If that happens the only thing you can do is disguise yourself with magic or objects. They'll set fire to your house if they aren't your friend.
en_grezzo: "Also, unlike me, other Adventurers are vicious. If you somehow make them angry, they'll still come after you even after defeating them or changing maps. If that happens the only thing you can do is disguise yourself with magic or objects. They'll set fire to your house if they aren't your friend."
it: E poi gli altri avventurieri, a differenza mia, portano rancore. Se per sbaglio li fai arrabbiare ti danno addosso a ogni incontro, anche dopo che li hai battuti o cambiato mappa. A quel punto non ti resta che travestirti con una magia o con l'oggetto giusto. E pare che a chi non è loro amico brucino la casa.

jp: 成長には休息も重要だ。冒険が一段落したらなるべく質のいいベッドで寝るといいだろう。ただしベッドは「使わなければ」意味がないぞ！寝てる間に装備が呪われたりしたら、すぐに癒し手のところへ行き解呪してもらうんだな。
jp_grezzo: "成長には休息も重要だ。冒険が一段落したらなるべく質のいいベッドで寝るといいだろう。ただしベッドは「使わなければ」意味がないぞ！寝てる間に装備が呪われたりしたら、すぐに癒し手のところへ行き解呪してもらうんだな。"
en: Resting is important to growth. After you complete an adventure you should sleep in the best you can find. But it's meaningless unless you use it! If your equipment is cursed while you sleep, you should quickly get over to a healer to uncurse it.
en_grezzo: "Resting is important to growth. After you complete an adventure you should sleep in the best you can find. But it's meaningless unless you use it! If your equipment is cursed while you sleep, you should quickly get over to a healer to uncurse it."
it: Anche il riposo conta, per crescere. Quando un'avventura è finita, dormi nel letto migliore che trovi. Ma se non lo usi non serve a niente! E se durante il sonno l'equipaggiamento ti si maledice, corri da un guaritore a fartelo purificare.

jp: まぁ、冒険者ギルドに所属しているならお前もマニュアルを持っているだろう。他にも色々と参考になることが書いてあるから、Shiftキーを押しながら？で読み返しておけ。

jp: なに…装備部位を、か？ああ、できないことはないぞ！俺が以前研究していた生体ハードポイント理論を応用すれば充分可能だ…未完成の技術だがな。生体ハードポイントの研究は特定部位の支持力を強化し必要に応じて義手や義足、義頭のようなアタッチメントを介することで本来は装備できないものも装着できるようにすることを目的としていた。しかし、この地で用意できる機材では制御がどうしても不安定になってしまうために中止となってしまってな。本体の細胞から新しく生やした方がよほど確実でコストも抑えられるし拒絶反応もないというのも大きな理由だ。一応、アタッチメントを用いる場合は本体と神経接続するため、本来の肉体に装備したものと遜色なく操れるようになるが、逆に取り外しを困難としてしまっている。理論上は…おっと、すまん。このまま解説すると長くなってしまうな。
jp_grezzo: "なに…装備部位を、か？ああ、できないことはないぞ！俺が以前研究していた生体ハードポイント理論を応用すれば充分可能だ…未完成の技術だがな。生体ハードポイントの研究は特定部位の支持力を強化し必要に応じて義手や義足、義頭のようなアタッチメントを介することで本来は装備できないものも装着できるようにすることを目的としていた。しかし、この地で用意できる機材では制御がどうしても不安定になってしまうために中止となってしまってな。本体の細胞から新しく生やした方がよほど確実でコストも抑えられるし拒絶反応もないというのも大きな理由だ。一応、アタッチメントを用いる場合は本体と神経接続するため、本来の肉体に装備したものと遜色なく操れるようになるが、逆に取り外しを困難としてしまっている。理論上は…おっと、すまん。このまま解説すると長くなってしまうな。"
en: A new equipment slot, is it? Ah, I just might be able to do it! Let's see. If I apply my previous biological hard point theory... Originally it was meant to strengthen a body part or add an additional part via an attachment similar to the power arm, but it had to be canceled for various reasons. We can use your own cells for the part, and then integrate it into your nervous system. Theoretically, we... Oops, sorry about that. I didn't mean to ramble on.
en_grezzo: "A new equipment slot, is it? Ah, I just might be able to do it! Let's see. If I apply my previous biological hard point theory... Originally it was meant to strengthen a body part or add an additional part via an attachment similar to the power arm, but it had to be canceled for various reasons. We can use your own cells for the part, and then integrate it into your nervous system. Theoretically, we... Oops, sorry about that. I didn't mean to ramble on."
it: Uno slot d'equipaggiamento nuovo, eh? Ah, forse ci riesco! Vediamo. Se applico la mia vecchia teoria dei punti d'aggancio biologici... All'inizio doveva rinforzare una parte del corpo, o aggiungerne una con un innesto come il braccio meccanico, ma fu sospesa per vari motivi. Prendiamo le cellule dal corpo e ci cresciamo sopra la parte nuova, poi la colleghiamo ai nervi. In teoria noi... Ops, scusa. Non volevo dilungarmi.

en_grezzo: "Sophia told me about the condition of this thing that she predicted based on reading its cumulative emissions... but it seems to be much weaker than that."
it: Sophia mi aveva detto in che stato doveva essere, contando quanto ha emesso finora... ma sembra molto più debole di così.

jp: 一度でいいから会いたいよ…。どうすれば会えるの？こいつらの知識を取り込めばわかるの？
jp_grezzo: "一度でいいから会いたいよ…。どうすれば会えるの？こいつらの知識を取り込めばわかるの？"

en_grezzo: "Father... How I long to see him, even if it's only once... What is it I must do to see him? If I absorb the knowledge of these people, will I find out?"
it: Padre... Vorrei vederlo, anche una volta sola... Che cosa devo fare per vederlo? Se prendo dentro di me il sapere di questa gente, lo capirò?

jp: 情けをかけるのは危険だ。仕留めるぞ。

en_grezzo: "Don't make the mistake of showing mercy. Let's finish this."
it: Avere pietà adesso è pericoloso. Finiamola qui.

jp: ミクラネシス様、いったい何があったのですか。
jp_grezzo: "ミクラネシス様、いったい何があったのですか。"

it: Mikraanesis, che cosa è mai successo?

jp: 今我々の本体が忘却の女神を食い止めている。いや…戦ってわかった。あれは正確には忘却を司る女神ではない。
jp_grezzo: "今我々の本体が忘却の女神を食い止めている。いや…戦ってわかった。あれは正確には忘却を司る女神ではない。"
en: Our main body is holding the Goddess of Oblivion at bay.... No. We know this from fighting them: the one responsible isn't exactly the goddess who rules oblivion.
en_grezzo: "Our main body is holding the Goddess of Oblivion at bay.... No. We know this from fighting them: the one responsible isn't exactly the goddess who rules oblivion."
it: Il nostro corpo principale sta trattenendo la dea dell'oblio. No... combattendo l'abbiamo capito: quella, a rigore, non è la dea che governa l'oblio.

jp: あれは世界規模で忘却という現象を起こすための概念存在…神という形で忘却の一側面が具象化したものだ。この世に何らかの記憶がある限り忘却という概念も同時に存在し続けるため、女神の姿を何度滅ぼそうと根源を取り除くことはできない。
jp_grezzo: "あれは世界規模で忘却という現象を起こすための概念存在…神という形で忘却の一側面が具象化したものだ。この世に何らかの記憶がある限り忘却という概念も同時に存在し続けるため、女神の姿を何度滅ぼそうと根源を取り除くことはできない。"
en: It is a conceptual entity that is used to create the phenomenon of oblivion on a global scale... the very embodiment of oblivion, in the form of a god. As long as memories continue to exist in this world, the concept of oblivion will continue to exist alongside them, and no matter how many times we destroy its form of a goddess, its origin cannot be excised.
en_grezzo: "It is a conceptual entity that is used to create the phenomenon of oblivion on a global scale... the very embodiment of oblivion, in the form of a god. As long as memories continue to exist in this world, the concept of oblivion will continue to exist alongside them, and no matter how many times we destroy its form of a goddess, its origin cannot be excised."
it: È un essere concettuale, fatto per produrre il fenomeno dell'oblio su scala di mondo... un aspetto dell'oblio che ha preso corpo in forma di divinità. Finché in questo mondo esiste un ricordo qualsiasi, insieme a esso continua a esistere il concetto di oblio: per quante volte se ne distrugga la figura di dea, la radice non si può togliere.

jp: もしも本体が完全体で降臨した場合、その世界のあらゆる存在は過去・未来に渡り完全に消滅する。、君にもあるはずだよ。もう内容はおろか題名すら思い出せない物語が。忘れてしまったことすら忘れている人物が。それが全世界・全宇宙規模で起こると思ってくれればいい。
jp_grezzo: "もしも本体が完全体で降臨した場合、その世界のあらゆる存在は過去・未来に渡り完全に消滅する。" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "、君にもあるはずだよ。もう内容はおろか題名すら思い出せない物語が。忘れてしまったことすら忘れている人物が。それが全世界・全宇宙規模で起こると思ってくれればいい。"
en: If its main body descends on the world in its complete form, all existence in that world will be completely annihilated in the past and future. , you must have one as well - a story that you can't even remember the title of anymore, let alone the content. A person who has forgotten that they have forgotten something. Just think of those calamities as happening on a global and cosmic scale.
en_grezzo: "If its main body descends on the world in its complete form, all existence in that world will be completely annihilated in the past and future. " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", you must have one as well - a story that you can't even remember the title of anymore, let alone the content.
